requirement.original: 修复为什么happy-dev的图片和文件上传功能失败？happy prod是正常运行的，这是在happy prod merge happy官方的最新的更新之后产生的
requirement.clarified: Fix broken file/image upload in happy-dev caused by missing happy-wire export after upstream merge
requirement.what: Restore AttachmentMetadata export from happy-wire package that was lost during upstream merge
requirement.why: File and image upload is non-functional in happy-dev web app; users cannot attach files to sessions

included: Add missing messageMeta export to happy-wire index.ts

success_criteria: yarn workspace happy-app typecheck has no AttachmentMetadata errors
File upload works end-to-end in dev.life-ai.app browser
constraints: Must keep the upstream voice export - add messageMeta alongside it
Must rebuild happy-wire before happy-app can consume the fix
Docker image must be built from happy-dev repo, not /root/happy

root_cause_analysis.symptom: File and image upload fails in happy-dev web app
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Upstream merge (925f5960) replaced local 'export * from ./messageMeta' with upstream 'export * from ./voice' in happy-wire/src/index.ts. The messageMeta.ts file still exists but is no longer exported from the package.
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: The upstream repo does not have the attachment feature. Their index.ts has voice instead of messageMeta. During merge, the local messageMeta line was replaced by the upstream voice line.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: AttachmentMetadata type is imported by 5+ files in happy-app. Without the export, TypeScript fails and runtime behavior is broken for all upload functionality.

context.codebase_state: happy-wire/src/messageMeta.ts exists with correct types but is not exported from index.ts
context.recent_commits: 925f5960 merge overwrote index.ts; f8b208fa originally added the export correctly

file_contents.packages/happy-wire/src/messageMeta.ts: Contains AttachmentMetadataSchema, AttachmentMetadata type, MessageMetaSchema, MessageMeta type

dependencies.happy-app -> happy-wire: AttachmentMetadata imported in useAttachments.ts, sync.ts, typesRaw.ts, typesMessage.ts, MessageAttachments.tsx, reducer.ts

environment.s3_bucket: happy-storage-dev on minio - exists and accessible

development_approach.strategy: One-line fix: add 'export * from ./messageMeta' to happy-wire/src/index.ts, then rebuild and deploy
development_approach.validation_approach: 1. yarn typecheck in happy-app (no AttachmentMetadata errors), 2. Docker rebuild happy-web-dev, 3. Browser test upload on dev.life-ai.app

research_findings.reason: Straightforward bug fix with clear root cause identified via git analysis

additional_typecheck_errors.error: Property 'applySessionUsage' does not exist on type 'StorageState'
additional_typecheck_errors.likely_cause: Method added locally but not present in upstream storage types
Local setting not added to upstream settings schema
Android-only, not relevant for web upload fix
